Priya (Docs): quick sync 11 drafting the 'minimal migration' note for the v1->v2 sunset email. keep it terse: two short examples (JS + Python), one rollback pattern, and a bullet list of top 4 gotchas.
Jules (SDK): good. can you include exact param rename table? people trip over rename: `invoke` -> `create`, `model` stays, `input` stays but streaming syntax changed. also call out the auth header name change in older SDKs.
Priya (Docs): yep. planned snippet JS: 
```js
// v1
const out = await client.models.invoke({ model: 'rwd-lite', input: prompt })
// v2
const out = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-lite-v2', input: prompt })
```
and Python: 
```py
# v1
out = client.models.invoke(model='rwd-lite', input=prompt)
# v2
out = client.responses.create(model='rwd-lite-v2', input=prompt)
```
Ana (Product): any note about model aliasing? we want to encourage customers to configure alias fallbacks before cutoff. one-line: "configure alias maps to auto-fallback to a compatible variant during rollout".
Priya (Docs): adding a tiny pseudo example: 
```js
// alias fallback config example (pseudo)
const alias = { primary: 'rwd-v2', fallback: 'rwd-v1-compat' }
// runtime: prefer primary, on specific errors switch to fallback
```
Jules (SDK): please add link to SDK compat matrix and to the streaming migration guide. we've had two broken snippets cause confusion; include CI note.
deploy-bot: PR build queued.
Priya (Docs): timeline: draft PR this afternoon, need Jules to review snippets by EOD. Ana can you confirm the rollback phrasing? leaving open for reviews.
